visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up shots focus on golden-yellow, circular corn cakes sizzling on a flat metal heating tray. A hand uses wooden tongs to shift the cakes, which have glistening, oily surfaces and some charred brown spots. The background shows a metallic cooking station with specialized circular molds. (2) A young man with glasses and a black baseball cap appears in a medium shot outdoors. He holds a single warm corn cake toward the lens, showing its oily exterior, before taking a significant bite. Behind him is a bright red storefront sign with large white characters. (3) The scene shifts inside a dimly lit, narrow food stall. A male worker wearing a yellow shirt and white apron moves a large tray of cakes, while a female worker in a green polo shirt stands nearby smiling. The background is packed with stainless steel steaming stacks and shelves of ingredients. (4) Detailed close-up shots show the production process: yellow liquid batter is poured into small round molds within a large pan. The blogger points his extremely oily, reflective index finger toward the camera, emphasizing the greasiness of the snack. His lips are also visibly shiny from the oil. (5) A woman in a floral dress holds a broken piece of corn cake inside a clear plastic bag. The interior of the cake is soft, fluffy, and bright yellow. The video concludes with a panning shot of the green and yellow storefront sign of the 'Ace Tender Corn Cake' shop in a crowded market.
